name: Kuda
product: Digital retail bank with app-based accounts, cards, and savings.
replicate: Full banking licence path is years of capital and compliance. App UX alone is not the product.
licences: CBN banking or MFB; NDIC; NDPR; card schemes.

name: Yellow Card
product: Crypto on/off-ramp and exchange for African markets; shifting to B2B treasury/stablecoins.
replicate: Exchange product buildable; multi-country VASP licensing and banking partners are hard.
licences: SEC Nigeria digital assets where applicable; CBN crypto circulars; VASP/MSB abroad; NDPR.

name: LemFi
product: Cross-border remittance and multi-currency accounts for diaspora.
replicate: Corridor licences and banking partners matter more than app UI.
licences: FCA and money transmission licences; CBN remittance rules; AML; NDPR.

name: Helium Health
product: EMR, hospital OS, financing, and health infrastructure software.
replicate: EMR features buildable; hospital sales cycles and clinical trust are slow.
licences: CAC; health data rules; NDPR.

name: Konga
product: Nigerian e-commerce marketplace with payments and logistics verticals.
replicate: Logistics and seller trust dominate. Pure software clone is insufficient.
licences: CAC; consumer protection; PSP partners; NDPR.

name: ThriveAgric
product: Tech-enabled farmer financing, inputs, and offtake.
replicate: Credit book plus field ops plus commodity risk. Debt-heavy.
licences: CBN finance/lending or partner banks; NDPR.

name: FairMoney
product: Digital lending and microfinance bank services.
replicate: Credit apps are common; MFB licence, collections, and cost of capital decide winners.
licences: CBN Microfinance Bank; credit bureaus; NDPR.

name: iSON Xperiences
product: Customer experience and BPO/tech services for enterprises.
replicate: Services business with tech overlay; not a pure product play.
licences: CAC; labour; NDPR.

name: Reliance Health
product: Digital HMO / health insurance and care access platform.
replicate: Insurance underwriting plus provider networks. High regulatory barriers.
licences: NAICOM HMO/insurance; NDPR; CAC.

name: 54gene
product: African genomics research and biobank platform (historical; operations wound down).
replicate: Lab infrastructure and ethics approvals. Not software-only.
licences: Research ethics; health research rules; NDPR/genetic data.

name: Nomba
product: Business payments, POS, and banking tools for merchants (formerly Kudi).
replicate: POS plus wallet competition is crowded; agent density and licences matter.
licences: CBN PSSP/PTSP/MMO/MFB as held; NDPR.

name: Wakanow
product: Online travel agency for flights, hotels, and African travel.
replicate: OTA software is commodity; IATA accreditation and supplier deals are the barrier.
licences: IATA/travel agency accreditations; CAC; NDPR.

name: MAX.ng
product: Motorcycle-first mobility and logistics in Nigerian cities.
replicate: Two-sided marketplace plus fleet ops plus city regulation.
licences: State transport permits; insurance; CAC; NDPR.

name: Kobo360
product: Digital freight marketplace matching truck owners with cargo shippers.
replicate: Freight matching buildable; working capital and insurance are hard.
licences: CAC; haulage permits; insurance.

name: Migo
product: Embedded consumer credit / instant loans via partners.
replicate: Credit models and partner distribution; regulated lending is the constraint.
licences: CBN lending/MFB or partner bank; credit bureaus; NDPR.

name: Paga
product: Mobile money and payments ecosystem for consumers and businesses.
replicate: Early MMO incumbent; licence and agent network still matter.
licences: CBN MMO; Super-Agent; NDPR.

name: Vendease
product: Food procurement and supply-chain platform for restaurants.
replicate: Procurement marketplace plus cold chain working capital.
licences: CAC; food safety; finance partners for supplier credit; NDPR.

name: Lemonade Finance
product: Multi-currency payments and accounts for African businesses and individuals.
replicate: Cross-border rails and compliance dominate; product surface is familiar.
licences: Money transmission / EMI in operating markets; AML; NDPR.

name: iROKOtv
product: African streaming / Nollywood content platform.
replicate: Streaming stack is commodity; content rights are the moat.
licences: Content licensing; NCC as applicable; NDPR.

name: Beacon Power Services
product: Energy management software and analytics for utilities and mini-grids.
replicate: Utility software sales are long-cycle; more buildable than grid finance plays.
licences: Utility procurement; NERC-adjacent; NDPR.
